what.sub: More than a dashboard. A system designed to help you navigate the crypto market.
what.p1: CRYPTO NOVA analyses market data, weighs opportunities against rules tested in advance and helps you understand what is happening with the market and with a portfolio.
what.p2: The mobile app is the interface to this system. It shows the public portfolio, positions and trades with their reasons, market analysis and NOVA AI's answers.
what.flow.cap: Hundreds of coins come in; few reach the portfolio: only what passes the system's checks.
what.l1.p: A server that runs 24/7: it collects data, analyses the market and tests ideas on history and on demo desks.
what.l2.p: CRYPTO NOVA's real account on OKX. The system's autopilot places the trades by the system's rules.
what.l3.p: Your window into the system: the portfolio, trades with reasons, NOVA AI, demo, lessons and the piggy bank.
what.l4.p: Where the money sits and trades are executed. Copying is a feature of OKX itself.
what.not.1: It doesn't trade in your account or get access to it.
what.not.2: It doesn't hold your money and can't withdraw it.
what.not.3: It doesn't promise profit: losses happen, and they are published.
what.not.4: It never asks for passwords, SMS codes, API keys or seed phrases.
how.lead: Four stages run without a break. Each one drops the weak part, so less comes out than went in.
how.s1.p: The system collects market data: coin prices and volumes, futures markets, the Fear & Greed index and news.
how.s1.d: Sources: the Binance, OKX and BingX exchanges, Hyperliquid, CoinGecko and news sites. It watches the market's {n} largest coins.
how.s2.p: Every few minutes the system reads the market: trend, support levels, volume, bitcoin's mood and coin quality.
how.s2.d: Coins in the spot portfolio go through a quality check: the project's economics, team activity, liquidity and price momentum. NOVA AI explains the conclusions in plain words.
how.s3.p: A new rule is first tested on history, on every coin including delisted ones, fees included. Then it trades on demo desks at real prices.
how.s3.d: {n} demo desks are running in parallel right now. Most ideas fail and are never used. Before every entry the system checks its risk limits.
how.s4.p: What passes becomes the system's rules. By them an autopilot runs the public portfolio on OKX, and the app shows the trades and their reasons.
how.s4.d: The account is split like this: spot portfolio 65%, extra core BTC, ETH and SOL 10%, futures 15% (long trades only, at most 1% of the futures budget at risk per trade, leverage up to 2), active spot «BTC momentum» 10%, which waits in BTC between trades.

why.h2: Why could CRYPTO NOVA be useful for you?
why.lead: You don't have to be a trader. The value is in transparency and understanding, not in promises of returns.
why.1.p: What's happening with bitcoin and the market, in plain words, without complex charts.
why.2.p: Entry, stop and a plain «why» for every trade the system makes.
why.3.p: CRYPTO NOVA's public portfolio on OKX and its full history since 22 Oct 2026.
why.4.p: Your own demo portfolio for any amount: virtual money, real prices.
why.5.p: The AI assistant explains the market and how the system works. 5 questions a day.
why.6.p: Upload an exchange statement and NOVA AI shows what the portfolio holds and where the risks are.
why.7.p: 52 short lessons with quizzes, from the first steps to a cold wallet.
why.8.p: A bitcoin savings plan: a small amount on a schedule.
why.note: No system guarantees profit. Crypto is high risk: only put in what you can afford to lose.

pf.rule.spot.d: Coins without leverage: the core of BTC, ETH and SOL, selected altcoins and a USDT reserve.
pf.rule.fut.d: Long trades only, on the system's selected signals. At most 1% of the futures budget at risk per trade, leverage up to 2.
pf.rule.core.d: On top of the spot portfolio's own shares, without leverage: bitcoin, ether and solana in the proportion 30 / 10 / 5.
pf.rule.active.d: When bitcoin jumps, the system briefly buys the most liquid altcoins, without leverage. Between trades this part waits in BTC; after an exit it stays in USDT for up to 3 days, until a new signal.
pf.open.none: No open positions right now: the system only enters on its own signals.

cn.lead: Three different things: watching, trying and copying. The first two are free and work at once. Copying is a feature of the OKX exchange.
cn.c1.p: The public portfolio, here and in the app. Nothing to connect.
cn.c2.p: A demo portfolio in the app: your amount, virtual money, real prices.
cn.c3.p: OKX repeats CRYPTO NOVA's trades in your account for the amount you choose. The app doesn't trade for you and doesn't see your account.
cn.s1: Sign up on OKX with CRYPTO NOVA's partner link.
cn.s2: Pass the identity check: a standard exchange requirement.
cn.s3: Top up the account in USDT.
cn.s4: Open CRYPTO NOVA's profile as a lead trader on OKX.
cn.s5: Tap «Copy», choose the amount and confirm.
cn.s6: You can stop copying in OKX at any time; the money stays in your account.
cn.guide: The full 7-step guide is in the app, in REAL mode.
cn.partner: The sign-up link is a partner link: the exchange gives CRYPTO NOVA part of its fee, and your terms don't change.
cn.fee.p: OKX keeps a share of the copier's profit for the lead trader, that is for CRYPTO NOVA. The percentage is shown in the profile before you start; no profit, no fee. Losses are possible.
cn.region.p: The availability of copy trading and of some instruments depends on your country and region — OKX shows the terms. CRYPTO NOVA's trades are visible in the app and in the OKX profile, and you can repeat them yourself. Where OKX doesn't serve customers, the app offers BingX if it works in your country; copying there comes later.
cn.safe1.p: We never ask for keys, passwords, SMS codes or seed phrases.
cn.safe2.t: The money is in your account
cn.safe2.p: The account is in your name. CRYPTO NOVA can't withdraw the money.
cn.safe3.p: And only where the law of your country allows it.
cn.risk: Copying is real trading: you can lose the money you put in. Your result can differ from the public portfolio because of the amount, fees and entry price. Past results don't guarantee future ones. Not financial advice.

earn.p0: No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.
earn.p1: For an account opened with our link, the exchange gives CRYPTO NOVA part of its fee. Your fees don't change.
earn.p2: OKX keeps a share of copiers' profit for the lead trader, CRYPTO NOVA. The percentage is shown before you start.
faq.a1: No. The app is free: the public portfolio, demo, lessons, piggy bank and NOVA AI (5 questions a day), with no subscriptions or purchases. If you copy CRYPTO NOVA on OKX, the exchange keeps a share of your profit for the lead trader; the percentage is shown in the profile before you start.
faq.q2: Does the app trade for me?
faq.a2: No. The app doesn't trade in your account, doesn't see it and doesn't hold money. Only OKX itself can repeat trades in your account, if you turn on copy trading. You can stop it in OKX at any time.
faq.a3: Yes. It's CRYPTO NOVA's real account on OKX: history since {since}, starting capital {start}. The system's autopilot places the trades. Deposits and withdrawals are not part of the result. Losing days and trades are shown just like winning ones.
faq.a4: In demo there's no money: the amounts are virtual. If you trade or copy for real, the money sits in your own exchange account. CRYPTO NOVA doesn't hold it and can't withdraw it. We never ask for passwords, SMS codes, seed phrases or API keys.
faq.q5: Can I copy from my country?
faq.a5: Copy trading is an OKX product. The availability of copy trading and of some instruments depends on your country and region — OKX shows the terms. CRYPTO NOVA's trades are visible in the app and in the OKX profile, and you can repeat them yourself. Where OKX doesn't serve customers, the app offers BingX if it works in your country; copying there comes later.
faq.a6: No. CRYPTO NOVA shows how the system works, explains the market and teaches. You make the decisions. Trading crypto is high risk: you can lose all the money you put in.
faq.q7: What if the system is wrong?
faq.a7: It makes mistakes, like any system, and they aren't hidden: losing trades are shown next to winning ones. Futures trades have a stop, and each trade uses only part of the account. There are no guarantees.
faq.a8: Not yet. The Android version is in closed testing on Google Play and can't be installed. Right now CRYPTO NOVA is on iPhone and iPad in the App Store.
faq.q9: NOVA AI didn't answer. What now?
faq.a9: If the server or the AI model doesn't answer in time, the app shows a message and a «Retry» button, and the question isn't counted. Try again in a minute. If it still doesn't work, write to support.
faq.a10: The founder and developer of the app is Dmytro Sukhyna. Write to cryptonova.app@gmail.com or on Telegram @crypto_nova_support.
faq.q11: I still have an old Pro or VIP subscription
faq.a11: Version 2.0 doesn't need it. To cancel: iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions, or Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.
final.p: Free on iPhone and iPad. The system is already running.
foot.about: CRYPTO NOVA is an AI system for crypto market analysis and an app to watch it and learn. Not an exchange, a broker or a financial adviser; it never holds your money. Trading crypto is high risk.
